decision.rule: adopt F only if, in every repository, the mean per-PR F - C hit@10 difference is at least 0.05 and its 95% bootstrap interval's lower bound is above 0; an interval containing 0 is inconclusive

rarity_rule: ignore a name when df(name) > 100; a downstream file referencing it earns 1/df(name); an upstream file declaring it earns 1/(df(name) * declaring_file_count(name)); a file matching both directions keeps the larger credit; score sums credits over distinct names
trial_rule: when more than 5 files are withholdable, keep the 5 with the smallest FNV-1a 64-bit hash of "<pr>/<path>", ties by path; otherwise keep all; trials run in listing order

validity_threats.circular_label: the label is co-change, and E predicts from earlier co-change, which favors E
validity_threats.one_repository_per_language: results cannot separate language from codebase
validity_threats.proxy_for_relevance: co-changed files stand in for the files a reviewer needed
validity_threats.small_sample: 50 PRs per repository detect only large effects
